description: Effective dates for the new criminal statutes replacing IPC, CrPC, and Evidence Act.
content: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) came into effect on July 1, 2024, replacing the colonial-era Indian Penal Code (IPC), Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), and Indian Evidence Act (IEA) respectively.

description: Key regulations for the use of AI in judicial systems proposed for 2026.
content: The Draft AI in Courts Regulations 2026, introduced in June 2026, outline the boundaries of artificial intelligence in the Indian judiciary. Key rules include: 1. No AI adjudication (AI cannot issue verdicts or binding legal decisions). 2. No black-box risk scoring for bail or sentencing. 3. Lawyer liability for AI hallucinations in submissions. 4. Mandatory disclosure of AI-use in any legal drafting or research presented to the court.
